patterns.note: Product feature sections consistently pair a descriptive text block (often left-aligned) with a detailed UI screenshot (often right-aligned or below), creating a clear visual association between text and product functionality.
Prominent, large, bold sans-serif headings are used for main sections, contrasted with smaller, lighter weight body text and occasional uppercase labels for emphasis.
A clean, high-contrast palette of white backgrounds and dark text is accented by vibrant blue for primary CTAs and a distinct pink/red for secondary highlights and interactive elements.
A prominent carousel immediately below the hero section cycles through key product capabilities, presenting large, icon-driven cards that animate horizontally.
Sections reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scroll, creating a dynamic and engaging content flow.
The homepage features distinct 'value proposition' sections that highlight key metrics (e.g., '10x', '62%') with large, bold numbers and concise descriptive text.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid white background to maintain visibility and compactness as the user moves down the page.

Key feature highlights are presented in a horizontally scrolling carousel, allowing users to browse multiple value propositions without leaving the hero area. This effect is achieved using a swiper component.
Content sections throughout the page are introduced with a subtle animation, appearing to fade or slide into view as the user scrolls down, creating a dynamic reveal effect for new content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (H1 ~4-5x body, H2 ~3x body) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by a legible, standard-sized body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius, e.g., 4-8px) applied consistently to buttons, cards, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, particularly in the hero and main section breaks, with content blocks having generous padding. Denser in the footer and detailed feature grids.

standout: The site effectively integrates detailed product UI screenshots directly into the narrative of each feature section, providing immediate visual context and proof of capability. This, combined with the prominent, data-driven value propositions and a clean, high-contrast design, creates a strong sense of authority and clarity for a complex enterprise product.
